content: Newsletters Print Minus Related Pages Newsletters / Members Meeting Updates 2026 2026 Q1 NHSN Newsletter [PDF – 1 MB] This edition features key updates and insights to support your work with NHSN. Highlights include changes to analysis and protocols, updates from the Antibiotic Use and Resistance (AUR) Module, and important information across several components: Healthcare Personnel Safety, Long-term Care Facility, Dialysis, and Biovigilance (Hemovigilance). You’ll also find reminders and other general NHSN news. 2025 2025 Q4 NHSN Newsletter [PDF – 1 MB] This edition provides key updates including analysis and protocol changes, AUR Module enhancements, highlights from the Healthcare Personnel Safety Component, Long-term Care Facility Component and NHSN Dialysis Component, Hemovigilance reminders and additional general NHSN news. We hope NHSN users find this newsletter informative and helpful in supporting efforts to improve healthcare quality and patient safety. 2025 Q2 NHSN Newsletter [PDF – 760 KB] This edition provides key updates including analysis and protocol changes, AUR Module enhancements, highlights from the Healthcare Personnel Safety Component, the NHSN Dialysis Component Q1 2025 QIP deadline, retirement of the CLIP Modules, hemovigilance reminders, and general NHSN news. We hope you find this newsletter informative and helpful in supporting your efforts to improve healthcare quality and patient safety.
